evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Natural-language Computer-Aided Design (CAD) code generation aims to turn design intent into executable and editable parametric programs.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Existing benchmarks and methods mostly focus on how closely the generated CAD model matches the reference geometry, often using metrics such as Intersection over Union (IoU).

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: The framework extracts actual constraints from the generated program, compares them with the expected constraints, and uses mismatches to localize and repair design violations.
